newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Costello sees strong Australian investment.
newsitem.headline: Costello sees strong Australian investment.

text.p: Australian Treasurer Peter Costello said on Monday that survey data pointed to very strong investment growth in some parts of the economy.

"Investment expectations surveyed by the Australian Bureau of Statistics point to very strong growth in 1996/97, particularly in mining and 'other selected industries'," Costello said in a speech to the Australian Stock Exchange.
"There is expected to be strength in both non-dwelling construction and plant and equipment investment in 1996/97."
Costello's August 20 budget forecast 14 percent year-average business investment growth for the year to June 1997.
